note: Default cadence for a leader. Times are local to the leader's timezone and sit off the top of the hour so shared schedulers are less likely to delay them. cadence-scheduler adjusts days and times to the leader's week and drops jobs whose skill does not apply to the archetype.

recurring.name: Weekly leader brief
recurring.why: Monday morning: what needs the leader this week, before the first meeting.

recurring.name: Policy radar
recurring.why: Thursday afternoon: catch the week's CMS, state and congressional moves before Monday's brief.

recurring.name: Friday action tracker close-out
recurring.why: Friday afternoon: update status, chase owners, flag slips while there is still a week to recover.

recurring.name: Contract notice-window watch
recurring.why: Tuesday morning: no notice deadline passes unprepared.

recurring.name: Monthly KPI pulse
recurring.why: Fifth of the month: month-end data has usually landed; triggers fire the right playbook.

recurring.name: Monthly data readiness re-check
recurring.why: Second of the month: try to upgrade every dependency one tier.

recurring.name: Monthly vendor resilience check
recurring.why: Twentieth of the month: BAAs, backups and downtime tests stay current.

recurring.name: Quarterly coding integrity audit
recurring.why: Mid-month after each quarter closes: compare coding patterns before payers do.

recurring.name: Quarterly board or investor update
recurring.why: Eighth of the month after quarter end: draft the update while numbers are fresh.

milestone_rules.calendar_prep: One-shot job at (event date - lead_days) for every applicable regulatory calendar event: prepare, and confirm the date still holds.
milestone_rules.calendar_day_of: One-shot job on the first business day on or after the event date: confirm what happened and update assumptions.
milestone_rules.action_checkpoint: One-shot job 14 days before each action's due date: is it on track, what is blocking it.
milestone_rules.action_due: One-shot job on each action's due date: verify the done-when condition with evidence.
